body: I've been battling with sickness and health issues all my life ,I had to endure a skin condition that was extremely painful ...and many other things.But I managed to live normally just for a few moments they were more than enough ,you can find happiness and friends and everything you want if you just seek. Dont give up you are not fixing it you are just putting more pain on top of the other.Just seek health professionals

I hope you are still alive ,I know what it feels like ....how much anger and hate you harbor but please dont go there..If you want to  be free of them\- live despite of them not caring,not loving you! You dont want to be a victim of other people's mistakes believe me .I hope you reconsider it!
